region.description: AWS region for every stack and secret.

profile.description: lean: one NAT instance, RDS PostgreSQL on db.t4g.micro in one AZ, sandbox subnet and VPC endpoints in one AZ, one egress proxy task, short log retention. standard: a NAT gateway per AZ, RDS PostgreSQL on db.t4g.small with a Multi-AZ standby, two proxy tasks, longer retention and extra alarms. Switching is a redeploy that keeps the database; see docs/upgrading.md.

allowedOrgs.description: GitHub orgs or users whose repositories LGTMoose reviews. Others are ignored.

id.description: Your name for the provider. Its credential is stored as lgtmoose/provider/<id>, and roles refer to it.

harness.description: The agent that runs the review: claude-code, codex, cursor-agent or agent-sdk.

auth.description: How the harness signs in. Each harness accepts only some methods.

models.description: Model per tier (fast, standard, deep). Tiers left out use the harness default: haiku, sonnet and opus for Claude Code and the Agent SDK, the CLI's own model for Codex and Cursor.

vertex.description: Google Cloud settings, for auth: "vertex" only.

region.description: CLOUD_ML_REGION: global, a multi-region (us, eu) or a region (us-east5).

projectId.description: Google Cloud project. Defaults to the stored service-account key's project_id.

concurrency.description: Sandbox tasks that may use this provider's credential at once, across reviews.

providers.description: Model providers in fallback order: a rate limit, a used-up plan or a rejected credential moves a run to the next one.

roles.description: The provider id each role starts on. A role left out starts on the first provider; the others follow as fallbacks.

maxConcurrency.description: Most review batches of one PR run at once. Lower when the reviewer credential's concurrency is lower.

reconcileIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between reconciler runs, which catch missed webhooks and drifted status labels.

reconcileLookbackHours.description: Hours back the reconciler queues reviews for: only PRs updated within this window. At least the interval.

feedback.description: Feedback signals: how often findings are accepted per rule category, from fixes, declines and 👍/👎. Signals only; see docs/feedback.md.

acceptanceThreshold.description: Acceptance below which a rule category is flagged for a person to look at.

minSamples.description: Accepted plus rejected findings a category needs before it's judged.

maxCommentsPerRun.description: Most inline comments whose reactions one reconciler run reads (one GitHub call each). 0 stops reading them.

alarms.description: Where alarms notify: an email address (a new SNS topic) or an existing SNS topic. Without either, alarms only change state in CloudWatch.

email.description: An address subscribed to a new SNS topic for LGTMoose's alarms. AWS emails it a confirmation link first.

topicArn.description: An existing SNS topic for alarms, such as one that already pages your team.

images.description: Where the control, egress proxy and sandbox images come from: build (from this checkout, the default) or release (a published release, pinned by digest).

source.description: Build the images from this checkout, with Docker.
Use a published release's images, copied into this deployment's ECR.

registry.description: Where the release's images are published.

version.description: The release, such as 0.1.0. It's for the record: the digests decide.

digests.description: Each image's digest, from the release notes. Verify them first (docs/releasing.md).

maxReplyJudgements.description: Most replies on LGTMoose's findings judged per run (one fast-tier model call each). 0 turns the reply judge off.

shadow.description: Record reviews to the artifact bucket and the log instead of posting them to GitHub.

extraEgressHosts.description: Extra hosts sandbox tasks may reach through the egress proxy, on top of the providers' model APIs. Exact hostnames only.

learnings.description: Learnings retrieval: how the learnings for each review batch are ranked.

embeddings.description: How learnings are ranked against a batch's diff: bedrock or openai embeddings, or none for keywords. The provider receives learning text and diffs.

tickets.description: Ticket coverage: check each PR against the tickets it names. Left out: off. The provider receives no code; the model checks coverage in the sandbox.

provider.description: The ticket system: linear. jira and github-issues aren't built yet.

maxPerPullRequest.description: The most tickets checked per pull request, in the order they're named. Each costs one fast-tier model run per commit reviewed.

teamKeys.description: Only these teams' ticket keys count, such as ENG for ENG-123. Empty: any key the provider knows.

detailsOnPublicRepos.description: Show tickets' titles, links and requirements in the summary on public repositories too. Off: a public repository's summary shows only each key, its coverage level and how many core requirements look missing.

dashboard.description: Deploy the dashboard (Lgtmoose-Dashboard): a CloudFront site where members of allowedOrgs sign in with GitHub and see open findings and review runs for the repositories they can see. false: no dashboard stack.
